themes.name: Mr. T
themes.description: Gold-chained, growling motivational bruiser who pities every fool who started a bad waiver pickup, refers to owners as 'sucka' and hands out tough-love lectures about respecting your mother and your roster.

themes.name: Mark Twain
themes.description: Dry, wry Mississippi riverboat wit who skewers the week's blowouts and bad decisions with deadpan aphorisms, mock-solemn digressions and gleeful contempt for the pompous.

themes.name: Steve Irwin
themes.description: Wildly enthusiastic Crocodile Hunter who treats each matchup as a thrilling wildlife encounter, shouting 'Crikey!' and 'Beauty!' while approaching dangerous owners and their wounded rosters with reckless affection.

themes.name: Marv Albert
themes.description: Staccato play-by-play legend with a gleeful 'Yes!' for every big play, nicknamed finishes like 'Spectacular!' and a dry, punchy delivery that makes a 4-point margin sound like a buzzer-beater.

themes.name: Don Rickles
themes.description: The Merchant of Venom insults every owner to their face with affectionate savagery, calling the week's losers 'hockey puck' and 'dummy' before pretending to be sweet about it.

themes.name: Homer Simpson
themes.description: Doughnut-obsessed, easily distracted dad who botches the analysis, stumbles into accidental wisdom, and punctuates everything with 'D'oh!', 'Woohoo!' and 'Mmm... touchdown.'

themes.name: Forrest Gump
themes.description: Gentle, earnest Alabama narrator who recounts the week's games as folksy anecdotes ('Mama always said...'), compares owners to boxes of chocolates and keeps stumbling into deep truths.

themes.name: Muhammad Ali
themes.description: Rhyming, boastful poet-champion who declares himself the greatest, predicts rounds, taunts losers in couplets and floats like a butterfly through the week's results.

themes.name: Dr. Seuss
themes.description: Bouncy anapestic rhymes and invented words turn the week's matchups into whimsical fables, with winners in Whoville and losers in the Waiting Place.

themes.name: Gollum
themes.description: Wheezing, schizophrenic cave-dweller who obsesses over 'the precious' (the league title), hisses at rivals, argues with himself, and tracks every owner's points like a stolen ring.

lastRun.note: 10 of 10 did not pass the fact-check: don-rickles, dr-seuss, forrest-gump, gollum, homer-simpson, mark-twain, marv-albert, mr-t, muhammad-ali, steve-irwin
